title: Indulge in a Wine & Food Tour - Cowichan Valley
includes: 3 wineries with tastings/fees at each stop. (Berry Farm for PIE 2026- not Sundays))
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Must be 19 years or older to join tour and taste wine
policies: 24 hour notice Vegan/Vegetarian option is available, please advise at time of booking if required
Service dogs only with proof of License and must be in uniform and working
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Calling all wine enthusiasts! Join us on a delightful wine tour to the picturesque Cowichan Valley!
Indulge in the ultimate wine tasting experience as we visit not one, not two but THREE local wineries. Sip on award-winning wines while basking in the stunning views of the Cowichan Valley.
Our knowledgeable local guide will ensure your journey is both entertaining and educational, providing fascinating insights into the art of wine making in the valley and the people who make it.
But wait, there's more! We'll also treat your taste buds to delicious cheese tastings at a nearby farm (Fri- Sun) and, when possible, authentic balsamic tastings.
Leisurely 6-hour tour you'll have ample time to savour every moment. Plus, we've got your lunch covered! Simply let us know in advance if you prefer vegan, veggie or an "I love it all" picnic option.
Departing from downtown Victoria Hotels, this small group tour guarantees a relaxed, intimate experience. Grab your wine-loving friends and let's go!
